messages:
sam: Quick midday challenge — 20min AMRAP of kettlebell swings + bodyweight squats, then a 2-mile cooldown run. Anyone up for a lunchtime micro-challenge? :sun_with_face: :kettlebell:

nina: I can do swings but only if someone times me. My lunch break is short tho. :sweat_smile:

mike: count me in. bringing the 16kg. can we start at 12:15?

sam: 12:15 works. plan: 20min AMRAP -> 5min mobility -> 2mi run. casual pace, no pressure.

tara: throwing down a gentle challenge — beat my last 2mi (10:40) and I buy coffee. :coffee:

leo: stakes accepted. can’t promise not to sprint the last 400m. :running_shirt_with_sash:

nina: @tara you bribing people with caffeine is unfair. i’m in.

mike: for everyone's sanity, quick rules: KBS Rx=16kg, 1 rep = 1 swing + 1 squat. Keep a tally on your phone.

sam: good call. Also: if anyone wants, route is the waterfront loop (flat, ~1mi) -> two laps.
extra_notes: run-bot will post results in thread after people log; please prefix your result with initials and time for the log. keep messages short — lunch schedules are real.
